Welcome aboard—happy to walk you through it! Here’s a simple starting roadmap:

Create an account & sign up: We’ll build a personalized meal plan for your dog and start you on a two-week trial. After that, orders ship every 4 weeks on a recurring basis, which you can change or cancel anytime.
Check your account: In your account you can manage what’s in each order, delivery timing/address, and payment details so your pup never runs out of food.
Transition slowly: To avoid tummy trouble, start with about 25% Nom Nom + 75% current food for days 1–2, 50/50 for days 3–4, 75% Nom Nom for days 5–6, then 100% Nom Nom on day 7.
Follow your pup’s portions: On the Pets page of your account, you’ll see your dog’s recipes, portion sizes, and a Feeding Guide with exactly how much to serve per meal.

That’s really the starting kit: sign up, set your plan, transition over a week, and follow the feeding guide in your account.

Nom Bot 2.0 · AI says:

Here are the main options, in plain language:

Meal plan settings (on the Pets page):

Recipes: Pick which flavors your dog gets.
Recipe options:
Fixed – same chosen recipes in every box.
Rotate – we switch through your chosen recipes each delivery.
Portion size:
Full portions – all Nom Nom.
Half portions – mix Nom Nom with other food.
Meal packs per day: Choose how many packs to serve each day; we split the daily amount into that many packs.

Activity level (in your dog’s profile):

Average – about 1 hour of activity daily.
Active – 2+ hours a day.
Athlete – 3+ hours of intense exercise. This helps us size meals correctly.

Feeding info & portions:

Your dog’s exact portion sizes and feeding guide live on the Pets page, so you always know how much to serve and when to start meals after a delivery (begin the morning after your box arrives so you don’t run out before the next one).

Account & subscription settings:

See and change what’s in each order, delivery timing/location, and payment details.
Orders repeat automatically; charges and past orders show in your order history.

Extras (treats & probiotics):

On the Extras page, you can add products as “One time” (next box only) or “Every box” (recurring).

Helping picky eaters:

Warm meals briefly in hot water.
Use Rotate to vary recipes each delivery.
Use Fixed with multiple recipes to get variety in every single box.

Getting started / trial:

New customers start with a two‑week trial, then move into a recurring 4‑week schedule, which you can change or cancel anytime before the order deadline.

Pricing basics:

Cost depends on things like number of dogs, age, weight, activity level, recipes, and your zip code (for tax). Our team can build a quote if you share those details.

Sampling & discounts:

You can try us first through Variety Packs at Chewy or Amazon, or single packs at PetSmart, then set up a subscription later.
First responders and military veterans can apply for a discount through our Pet Support Team.

If you tell me what you’re trying to adjust (recipes, price, extras, or schedule), I can walk you through just those options step by step.
